paper_span.quote: Let \(E/F\) be the Frattini quotient extension corresponding to \(G/\Phi(G)\), and put \(d=d(G)\) and

decls.rationale: Makes Step 2's Frattini quotient extension \(E/F\) well defined: \(\Phi(G)\) is open and normal of 3-power index in \(G\), so \(G/\Phi(G)\) is finite and corresponds to a finite extension \(E/F\) — the field Chebotarev is then applied to.
